items.title: Just how big of a problem area is China for Nvidia?
items.summary: Josh Lipton uses Yahoo Finance's AlphaSpace platform to take a closer look at Nvidia's (NVDA) post-earnings stock gains. He is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to further examine China's place in the broader, global AI ecosystem and how much the nation factors into Nvidia's chip business.
